author.role: Prior C TU/tests author and new design candidate author; not independent design acceptance or actual host reviewer

initial_context.prior_evidence_limit: Prior fixed four-role normal/controller_loss returned CPU observations do not supply surviving guardian/adoption, production containment, arbitrary descendants/exec, model runtime or resource/queue restoration interfaces.

fixed_seven_source_closure.utility_hash_provenance: Inherited declared source identities from accepted prior source design/declaration; no fresh source hash scan performed for this candidate.
fixed_seven_source_closure.no_old_entrypoints: The new observer may reuse captured-byte pure build/link/verification utilities; it must not invoke old observe/CLI, old products, requests, attempts, controllers or execute paths.

topology.fixed_tree: guardian G -> coordinator C -> guard H -> fixed non-model worker W
topology.creation: G forks C once, C forks H once, H forks W once. No exec, further fork, services, respawn, external PID or arbitrary command. All four initial roles exist and are identity-bound before ARM and every deliberate parent loss.
topology.survival_assumption: G remains alive on the same trusted host throughout each bounded case. Guardian/Python-observer/host loss is not a tested or guaranteed recovery path.
topology.identity_binding: G independently reads and rechecks four initial PID/PPID/start_ticks/boot_id/UID/EUID and product/stat identity against private role packets and expected fork edges; same birth/boot/UID/product/nonce must remain invariant through allowed PPID transitions.
topology.limits: Forked source/product/stat binding is not full mapped-code, continuous byte authentication, authenticated whole ancestry/node alias, physical exclusion or a sandbox.

subreaper_protocol.symbolic_interface: prctl from reviewed sys/prctl.h, using PR_GET_CHILD_SUBREAPER and PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER; no guessed numeric options or syscall/provider substitution.
subreaper_protocol.before_any_fork: G GET must succeed with value0; then SET1 and GET1 must both succeed. Unexpected initial1, missing interface, failed call or inconsistent value blocks fork/ARM and remains a negative prerequisite.
subreaper_protocol.children: C/H/W explicitly GET and report0 before READY; do not infer non-inheritance without observation. Unexpected values reject before deliberate loss.
subreaper_protocol.terminal_reset_gate: Only after the exact case terminal/parent-wait predicate is complete, all three managed roles are proven reaped by the proper owners and G-owned descriptor closure is complete may G SET0/GET0. No unconditional reset on an unknown/adoption-incomplete negative path.
subreaper_protocol.reset_failure: Attempted SET0 failure, GET0 failure/nonzero or missing facts prevents success. Preserve exact errno/value and partial state; no setter retry or global/queue restoration claim.
subreaper_protocol.state_is_owned_process_local: A successful reset concerns G only. G/host loss may prevent final JSON/reset and is not represented as recovered.

headers_CPP_machine_contract.parsing: Pinned utility CPP parser remains unchanged. New observer separately token-recognizes bounded expanded numeric C expressions for additional long markers without evaluating or substituting expressions. The declared compiler evaluates symbolic constants; runtime emits its compiled observations.
headers_CPP_machine_contract.typed_bounds: Header/target facts, packet sizes, integer/UID/PID/FD/status/tick/clock/deadline fields must match captured C machine bounds. No bool-as-int, negative identities, overflowed additions, unsupported widths or assumed endian/layout. Descriptor0 is legal; source labels determine FD meaning.
headers_CPP_machine_contract.call_signatures: Use reviewed declared syscall/prctl/poll/waitpid/fcntl/close/fork signatures from captured headers; pidfd entry numbers only SYS_pidfd_open/SYS_pidfd_send_signal. Signal only SIGKILL with null siginfo and flags0. No old Python API shim.

opens_after_relevant_fork.G_C: G opens C after G forks C
opens_after_relevant_fork.C_H: C opens H after C forks H
opens_after_relevant_fork.H_W: H opens W after H forks W
opens_after_relevant_fork.G_H: G opens H after private identity forwarding and live validation
opens_after_relevant_fork.G_W: G opens W after private identity forwarding and live validation

pidfd_handles.before_ARM: G has C/H/W anchored; C has H handle; H has W handle. Opening binds before/after identity checks, fdinfo and nonterminal poll observations. No parent loss until all anchors/READY/ACK match.
pidfd_handles.duplication: Five separately opened handles may target the same original H/W. None is inherited by a later child because opening occurs after the corresponding fork and no ancestor forks again. All other inherited input/product/stdio/pipe duplicates are explicitly closed before READY.
pidfd_handles.explicit_close_evidence: Exactly one close per live owned handle followed immediately by F_GETFD/-1/EBADF; preserve actual fd number and any reuse separately.
pidfd_handles.H_W_on_SIGKILL: H owns W handle until G kills H. Its descriptor teardown follows process exit; explicit close was not observed and close/EBADF fields must remain null. Never fabricate five explicit closes.

private_pipe_packet_protocol.endpoint_policy: Each final role retains only its own edge endpoints needed by its stage; intermediates retain downstream endpoints only until the corresponding fork, then close their copies. Children close unrelated ancestor endpoints before READY. G is the sole final-JSON stdout writer.
private_pipe_packet_protocol.packet_bound: Purpose-built fixed small frame kinds, at most512bytes per frame; compile sizeof assertions against symbolic PIPE_BUF and runtime positive fpathconf(_PC_PIPE_BUF) check. Never forward the expanded final guardian JSON.
private_pipe_packet_protocol.forwarding: H forwards W frames separately; C forwards H/W frames separately and unchanged. G checks exact expected roles, order, case, nonce, epoch and one occurrence per required kind. Partial/duplicate/malformed/out-of-order frames do not authorize an action.
private_pipe_packet_protocol.ARM_order: G->C->H->W; W ACK is collected by H; H ACK and W facts are collected by C; C sends final ALL_ARM_ACK to G. Loss actions require G receipt plus fresh live identity/anchor checks.
private_pipe_packet_protocol.worker_after_ACK: After receiving ARM, W closes command read and can include its actual close/EBADF in ACK; W sends ACK then closes report write and parks to its fixed absolute self-expiry. No EOF-driven worker exit, new fork, exec or work beyond the fixed wait.
private_pipe_packet_protocol.report_writer_close_precision: A role cannot report close return/EBADF after closing its sole writer. H observes W-report EOF while W pidfd remains nonterminal; C analogously observes H-report EOF while H remains alive. Distinguish this parent observation/source path from a nonexistent explicit writer-close return receipt.
private_pipe_packet_protocol.guard_after_ACK: H closes worker pipe endpoints, closes its command read before ACK, sends ACK and closes report write, then parks without EOF or C-loss autoexit/worker cleanup. H keeps H_W handle until its deliberate SIGKILL.
private_pipe_packet_protocol.coordinator_after_ACK: C closes H pipe endpoints, forwards all ACK/EOF/close facts, and retains G command/report edge plus C_H handle. It never forks again.

ordered_steps: Verify ALL_ARM_ACK, all initial identities and live anchored roles; G sends exactly one SIGKILL through G_H.
C polls C_H and waits its own H exactly once successfully; raw status9/SIGKILL9 must match original H. C reports GUARD_WAIT_FACT and remains alive until FINISH.
G independently checks H anchored terminal observation and C matching parent-wait fact; then observes same W.PPID changed H->G while C remains alive.
G records adopted W birth/boot/UID/product invariants and presignal snapshot, sends exactly one SIGKILL via G_W, polls terminal and waits its adopted W/raw9 exactly once successfully.
G sends FINISH to C; C explicitly closes C_H with immediate EBADF, reports FINISH_ACK, closes remaining pipes and exits0; G polls/waits original direct C/raw0.
G verifies complete role/reap/FD predicate, closes G_C/G_H/G_W and only then SET0/GET0 and final success JSON.
Verify ALL_ARM_ACK and all anchored live identities; G sends separate COORDINATOR_EXIT23 packet.
C explicitly closes C_H and records immediate EBADF, reports EXIT_ACK, closes its remaining pipes and _exit(23), without waiting/cleaning H or creating any new worker.
G polls G_C and waits its direct C/raw5888 (exit23). Then independently observes same H.PPID C->G while same W.PPID remains H.
Only after this H adoption snapshot/invariants does G send exactly one SIGKILL via G_H; G polls and waits adopted H/raw9.
G independently observes same W.PPID H->G with birth/boot/UID/product invariant; then sends exactly one SIGKILL via G_W, polls and waits adopted W/raw9.
G verifies complete role/reap/FD predicate, closes G_C/G_H/G_W and only then SET0/GET0 and final success JSON.

deadline_contract.clock: Captured CLOCK_MONOTONIC t0 in G before preparation/forks, inherited through the fixed source; no reset of epoch or relative-time extension.
deadline_contract.work_gate: Initial GET/SET/GET, forks, private identity/handle exchange, complete ACK and primary parent loss belong within work deadline.
deadline_contract.cleanup_gate: Required adoption snapshots, exactly authorized H/W signals and successful owned waits complete within cleanup deadline.
deadline_contract.terminal_gate: C FINISH in guard_loss, complete raw matching/FD closure and reset five-fact predicate belong within terminal deadline; G reports by total deadline.
deadline_contract.checks: Overflow-safe machine-bounded additions and nondecreasing observed clock values; every blocking wait uses remaining absolute budget. Zero/negative remainder refuses new action. Child self-expiry is fallback source behavior, not guardian cleanup proof.
deadline_contract.negative_state: At the first stage error or expiry, all future planned signals/commands stop permanently. Absolute child+14s expiry remains bounded source behavior only; G ending at+12s does not prove later descendant cleanup or reaping.

negative_unknown_protocol.no_success_inference: Signal rc0 alone does not prove death; pidfd terminal alone does not prove adoption or correct parent wait; raw wait alone does not prove a PPID snapshot. No case conversion or inferred parenthood.
negative_unknown_protocol.worker_restriction: The only G_W signal is the respective case planned once-SIGKILL, before any error and after same-identity W.PPID=G adoption plus required preceding H parent-wait facts. Negative state permits no W signal even if adoption is later observed. G wait W, including negative observation, still requires correct ownership and proved adoption; H alive means W remains H child.
negative_unknown_protocol.guard_restriction: The only G_H signal is the declared armed case once-SIGKILL before any error: guard_loss after complete ALL_ARM_ACK/live identity gates; coordinator_loss after C exit23/own wait5888 plus H.PPID=G and W.PPID=H snapshot. There is no fresh-member-policy or negative-cleanup eligibility. G_C is never signalled, and C/H/W issue no directed signals.
negative_unknown_protocol.ledger: Retain a combined per-original-handle attempt ledger for all paths, plus an explicitly empty negative-cleanup-signal ledger. After first error record unused planned attempts as disabled, never silently continue to W. Poll/wait attempts, zero returns/errors and one correctly owned matching successful reap are recorded separately; observations do not grant signal eligibility.
negative_unknown_protocol.partial_membership: Preserve distinct exact known-created, bound, adoption-proved, terminal-observed, correctly-reaped and unknown sets. No missing packet, child source path, self-expiry deadline, process disappearance or raw wait substitutes for a missing identity/adoption/parent-wait fact. No unknown descendant is assumed owned.
negative_unknown_protocol.reset: The r1 reset gate is not weakened: all3 original managed roles require complete correct-parent terminal/reap proof, complete G handle closure and the exact case-success predicate before terminal SET0/GET0. No reset while terminal/reap/adoption or membership is incomplete. Negative/unknown state never gains case success or a self-expiry cleanup guarantee; failed/unverified reset remains failed.
negative_unknown_protocol.consumption: Any later declared host case is single-use, including failure/partial result. No retry/resume/fallback, regenerated request, stale argv/PID/root/marker/product reuse or independent retrieval claim without new evidence.
negative_unknown_protocol.signal_budget: Across planned, negative cleanup and every branch combined, each immutable original handle tag has at most1 directed signal attempt. G_H and G_W are the only signal-eligible handles, only at their exact armed case gates; G_C, C_H and H_W have budget0. Set attempt-consumed before the syscall; any result including EINTR, ESRCH, failed or ambiguous return consumes that original handle forever. FD-number reuse does not create another budget.
negative_unknown_protocol.stop_on_first_error: The first failed/missing/ambiguous required fact, operation or deadline irreversibly enters negative state. From that boundary every later planned signal is forbidden, including an as-yet unattempted W signal with otherwise unused budget. No negative cleanup signal and no new ARM/EXIT23/FINISH managed-role command may be issued after that boundary; already-issued operations retain their actual results, with no retry or case conversion.
negative_allowed_operations: Bounded read/identity observation and poll on already known original members within remaining G deadline
Correctly owned identity-verified wait; an adopted H/W additionally requires its explicit same-identity PPID=G adoption observation before G wait
Once-close G own known handles and own pipe endpoints; preserve real close/error facts without reopening/replacing/reusing a consumed handle
Author a best-effort bounded error/partial receipt with exact known/unknown sets; this does not guarantee receipt completion or durability

role_source_on_failure.shared: All created C/H/W inherit the same t0 and absolute self-expiry t0+14s; no branch respawns, execs, installs, signals, adds children or extends its epoch. An actual source error may cause early nonzero exit; every such outcome is negative/unknown rather than claimed cleanup. Source expiry behavior is not proof that any child terminated/reaped after G/host loss.
role_source_on_failure.G: On first error cease all planned signal and managed-role command issuance permanently. Until its remaining total deadline, only bounded observation/poll, correctly-owned identity/adoption-proved wait and once-close of own known descriptors are allowed. Preserve all unknown sets and observed error results. Best-effort final failure/unknown output may be partial; no signal retry, rescue action or reset on incomplete reaps.
role_source_on_failure.C: Before/while forwarding READY/ARM/ACK or while waiting H/FINISH, a local error stops command forwarding and triggers bounded once-close of own known descriptors followed by early nonzero exit. It does not signal H/W or promise descendant cleanup. While healthy and parked, absent the exact permitted case command it only waits within t0+14s; expiration exits nonzero. EXIT23 and FINISH/exit0 remain the exact planned paths only.
role_source_on_failure.H: Before/while creating its single W or forwarding READY/ARM/ACK, a local error stops all further commands and closes its own known descriptors once before early nonzero exit; no directed signal or descendant-cleanup claim. After ACK and pipe closure it parks only to t0+14s with H_W retained; expiration/errors may close it and exit nonzero. Planned G SIGKILL H produces kernel teardown, not an invented explicit close.
role_source_on_failure.W: Before/while READY/ARM/ACK a local error closes its own known descriptors once and may exit early nonzero. After ACK it closes control/report pipes and stays in its fixed finite wait to t0+14s, with no EOF-triggered exit, fork, exec or signal. Self-expiry exits nonzero but is never substituted for G adoption-based planned signal/poll/wait success.

C_JSON_interface_candidate.typed_null_rule: Unattempted facts retain attempted=false and result/errno/value=null; never defaults that resemble successful syscalls. Missing independent/raw bodies remain missing, not reconstructed.
C_JSON_interface_candidate.acceptance_note: This is the declarative candidate interface for independent design review. Detailed implementation layout must remain within it; substantive interface changes require a new retained design amendment before implementation acceptance.
C_JSON_interface_candidate.refinement_reason: Exact runtime scope name; broad unavailable/recovery flags only in C controls. Acceptance, source-freeze, host-declaration/launch and independent receipt state belong to observer/run metadata.

portable: Closed case/nonce/source/request and machine-bound validation with no production execute bypass
Reject missing or forged adoption snapshots despite raw wait or signal success
Reject W.PPID=G claimed immediately after C death while H still alive
Correct parent-wait owner/raw status and exact H/W signal ledger for both cases
Distinguish four explicit pidfd closes from H_W SIGKILL teardown
Reject attempted-false syscall facts carrying invented success defaults
Preserve partial/error/reset-negative facts and broad false flags
Any planned H attempt returning EINTR/ESRCH/ambiguous error consumes H budget and disables the unattempted W planned signal; negative signal ledger must remain empty0
A success-shaped late adoption after first error permits only correctly-owned read/poll/wait observation, never re-enables H/W signals or case success
No G_C, C_H, H_W or C/H/W directed signal path, no fresh-handle/FD-reuse budget reset, and no terminal reset with incomplete known/unknown reap sets
strict_Linux_actual_fixtures: Fresh owned guard_loss must show C wait H/raw9, G W adoption-presignal snapshot, G wait W/raw9, C exit0 and five successful G subreaper facts
Fresh owned coordinator_loss must show H adoption while W remains H child, C exit23, G wait H/raw9, W adoption-presignal snapshot and G wait W/raw9
Worker must remain alive after report/control closure and H death until G adoption-based cleanup, preventing EOF autoexit or worker-creation race from masquerading as cleanup
meaningful_fixture_plan_only.failure_boundaries: Meaningful controlled portable/owned CPU cases for incomplete ACK/adoption/terminal/reset outcomes; preserve actual stage and unknown states. They are fixtures, not model or natural external trials.

sequencing_gates: Independent non-source-author reviewer reads the actual retained r1 review and these actual r2 candidate bytes for narrow acceptance of the closed negative policy/interface refinement. No observer/C/tests/docs implementation before explicit accepted r2; candidate does not accept itself.

After accepted design, implement exactly the four new paths while preserving the three immutable utility sources and science/native/data/plan/freeze. Verify meaningful portable and strict actual Linux CPU fixtures in their proper platform scope.

New source closure then requires commit/push, independent source/committed/saved-CI reviews, attached PR, every latest exact-source-head CI and actual main integration. Source CI is GitHub CPU evidence, not MS host evidence.

Only after source integration may separate fresh exact-prelaunch review bind allowed host, input/source/toolchain/header/product/request identity, new scope/nonce/root/path/attempt and one bounded non-model case. No host declaration or launch is created here.

Any observed host result requires independent actual/preservation/publication/committed review, report push/attached PR/exact-head CI/main result integration before another source stage; failures remain consumed.

Later controlled model/native bridge, full76pins/positions/pipcheck/source/data/weights/ABI/Tensor/gradient, GPU lease and independent original-queue restore remain separate prerequisites; no boolean enables old execute.
